deploybot: [migration-slot] Requesting maintenance window 03/23 02:00-03:00 UTC for migration m-5128 (add functional index on users(email_normalized) + compact backfill). Please ack within 10m or slot will be released. canaries=2.
Nina: FYI: plan is CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY then atomic rename during a short lock. Backfill is chunked with worker pool; default throttle=400r/s. Estimated build time ~18-35min depending on shard.
Rahul: Do we have DB-side replay risk if we hit hot-update churn? Any chance of bloat/regression on replicas?
Nina: We expect minor bloat; autovacuum tuned for hot indexes. Replica lag throttle: if lag > 25s for 90s, pause workers and alert.
SRE-oncall: I'll add an on-the-fly autothrottle: reduce to 150r/s and notify #eng-sre if lag persists >3m. Health gates: p99 auth latency, replication lag, and long tx count.
Lucy: I'll take the cutover. I'll be online from 01:50-03:20 UTC. Can someone pin the canary nodes to release-3.2.0-dbfix to avoid schema mismatch?
Rahul: Pin to release-3.2.0-dbfix for canaries, yes. If canary errors we roll back to release-3.1.9. Also add feature-flag gated=true around new code path.
deploybot: Holdpoint created: manual-unpin required to proceed to global rollout. Preflight checks enabled.
Nina: Runbook (sanitized snippets):
```
-- preflight
SELECT now();
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction';
SELECT application_name, state, replay_lag FROM pg_stat_replication LIMIT 5;
-- progress
SELECT migration_id, phase, total_chunks, done_chunks FROM migration_tracker WHERE migration_id='m-5128';
```
Lucy: Good. Rahul, please paste SQL you plan to run so we can quick review.
Rahul: SQL (redacted):
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS users_email_norm_idx_shadow ON users ((lower(email_normalized))) WITH (fillfactor=85);
-- background worker will fill in chunks
-- cutover: BEGIN; LOCK TABLE users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX users_email_norm_idx_shadow RENAME TO users_email_norm_idx; COMMIT;
```
Nina: Add an extra safety: keep old index named users_email_norm_idx_old for 15m post-swap, then drop asynchronously. This gives quick revert path if unexpected regressions.
SRE-oncall: Revert options: 1) abort before swap 12 no user impact, let old index stay; 2) after swap, rename new->active, old->old, revert by swapping names under a short lock (brief). Documented rollback steps in thread.
Lucy: I'll run smoke tests after canary cutover: curl /health and profile query check. If curl /api/profile?email=test@x.com takes >200ms, abort. I'll paste timestamps and metrics here.
ops-bot: Note: release notes auto-gen will include migration id m-5128; tagging release-3.2.0-dbfix.
Rahul: One more: ensure metric suppression for duplicate index_metrics for 45m to avoid alert fatigue.
SRE-oncall: Patching dashboards to suppress noise. Setting pager cooldown for this migration.
Nina: I'm claiming slot now and will kick off canary at 02:00 UTC. deploybot: start canaries and post status updates.
deploybot: Slot claimed. Canary rollout scheduled. Will post canary health and final go/no-go within thread.
